gloss: imperial throne; the position of emperor

definitions.gloss: imperial throne; the position of emperor
definitions.explanation: The status or position of the emperor. Used in discussions of succession, abdication, and the institution of the Japanese monarchy.

examples.japanese: {皇位|こうい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{継承|けいしょう}する→継承する：17346_keishousuru⟧。
2019⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{皇位|こうい}⟦{継承|けいしょう}→継承：13841_keishou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The imperial succession took place in 2019.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上皇|じょうこう}→上皇：28559_joukou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{皇位|こうい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{退|しりぞ}かれ→退く：20858_shirizoku⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{天皇|てんのう}→天皇：04546_tennou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{即位|そくい}→即位：11974_sokui⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The Emperor Emeritus abdicated, and the new Emperor ascended the throne.

notes:
USAGE:
{皇位|こうい} is composed of {皇|こう} (emperor, imperial) and ⟦{位|い}→〜位：00443_i⟧ (position, rank). It refers specifically to the position of the Japanese Emperor (⟦{天皇|てんのう}→天皇：04546_tennou⟧).

Note: Do not confuse with the homophones ⟦{好意|こうい}→好意：12207_koui⟧ (goodwill, kindness) or ⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧ (act, deed).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {皇位|こうい}⟦{継承|けいしょう}→継承：13841_keishou⟧ (imperial succession)
- {皇位|こうい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就|つ}く→就く：10123_tsuku⟧ (ascend to the throne)
- {皇位|こうい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{退|しりぞ}く→退く：20858_shirizoku⟧ (abdicate)
- {皇位|こうい}⟦{継承|けいしょう}→継承：13841_keishou⟧⟦{順位|じゅんい}→順位：14679_juni⟧ (order of succession to the throne)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In 2019, Emperor Akihito (⟦{上皇|じょうこう}→上皇：28559_joukou⟧{明仁|あきひと}) abdicated — the first such abdication in over 200 years — and Emperor Naruhito ({今上天皇|きんじょうてんのう}{徳仁|なるひと}) ascended the {皇位|こうい}, beginning the Reiwa era.
